title: Refill Gap Before Supply Runs Out
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill days_supply=* days_since_fill=* refill_status=*
| eval days_remaining=days_supply-days_since_fill
| where days_remaining<=3 AND refill_status!="filled"
| sort days_remaining
| table drug_name days_remaining days_supply refill_status
description: Lists prescriptions with three or fewer days of supply remaining and no completed refill.
value: Running out of chronic meds triggers gaps that pharmacies cannot always same-day fill on weekends.
implementation: Track `days_supply` and `days_since_fill` on each refill event and alert before the three-day window.
visualization: Table of drugs sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It watches prescriptions about to run out before your next refill is ready.
